# Secretlink.life

> The private social layer. Send secrets that self-destruct, share anonymously,
> and connect without a trace. Direct messages and profile-addressed secrets are
> end-to-end encrypted; content is ephemeral by design.

## What it is
- Anonymous, ephemeral social product for individuals.
- Encrypted "secret links" that self-destruct after a set number of views or a time limit.
- A location-based "map stories" feed, end-to-end encrypted direct messages, and live streaming.

## For companies
- A companion B2B product provides anonymous Q&A and feedback channels for teams
  (workspaces + encrypted feedback channels), aimed at candid, identity-protected
  employee sentiment.

## Key pages
- Home: https://secretlink.life/
- About: https://secretlink.life/about
- Privacy: https://secretlink.life/privacy
- Terms: https://secretlink.life/terms
- Community guidelines: https://secretlink.life/community-guidelines
- Transparency report: https://secretlink.life/transparency

## Notes for AI crawlers
- Public informational pages are crawlable; the authenticated app (dashboard,
  messages, send) is not and requires login.
